source_final_state: Absent/null identity; 3D translation or 6D XYZ Euler radians then translation; source shapes preserved
collision: Original triangle BVH neighborhoods plus deterministic per-material-sample signed distance/initial-point baseline for extraction; uncapped CoACD only for MuJoCo residual stability

source_collision_quality.limitation: Finite deterministic samples, not an exact equality proof.

pose_candidates.transform: whole-assembly rigid transform only; ground actual mesh min z

fixture_policy: Exactly one original permanent external anchor; frozen pose order, descending mass/source volume/world-XY footprint/numeric ID; no second anchor or dynamic holding
selection: Frozen metadata-only source order;initial physics only;no reference-path or actor-result gate
endpoint: Full assembly disassembly to at most one remaining original component (n-1 removals).
legacy_target: Nonfixed focus ID is compatibility metadata, not a selective-retrieval goal.
development_calibration: outputs/development/physics + unchanged real_v3 geometry regression tests
extraction_scope: Fixed-quaternion straight source-axis translations; discrete 1mm poses; material samples/containment/support-plane checks are finite/conservative, not a continuous exact collision proof
source_geometry_tuning: No post-freeze changes; original geometry/relative placement preserved
